description: Brought eighteen hundred and two pillories as report.
name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

description: Refused to invent a part, and refused the number as his own count.
name: John Heminges

description: Said the yard did not listen, and would not speak for Cheapside.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Said he had no part, and that he was not in Cheapside.
name: William Shakespeare
